page.title: Roles
page.consoleHint: Console roles apply across the whole console: tenants, the brand list, users and roles. Each user has at most one. Brand roles are managed inside each brand, on its Roles page.
page.brandHint: These roles belong to this brand’s tenant. You can assign them on any of the tenant’s brands, and a change applies on all of them.

table.name: Name
table.ownRole: You can't change a role you hold.
table.beyondLimit: This role holds actions you can’t grant.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.builtinHint: The built-in Admin role holds every console action and can't be changed.
dialog.builtinBrandHint: The built-in Brand Owner role holds every brand action and can’t be changed.
dialog.lackedHint: You can only grant console actions you hold yourself.
dialog.lackedBrandHint: You can only grant brand actions you may grant on this brand. Customer scores and customer IDs also need a brand role of your own that holds them.
dialog.brandHint: This role belongs to the tenant. Editing it changes it for everyone who holds it, on any of the tenant’s brands.
dialog.assignedUsersHint: To change who holds this role, use the Users page or the brand's Members tab.
dialog.assignedUsersBrandHint: Holders across all of the tenant’s brands. To change who holds this role, use each brand’s Members page.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: This role will be removed permanently. A role that is assigned to users can't be deleted.
